reviewMethod: Actual saved model inputs, raw predictions and final images visually inspected on 14 October 2026. Qualitative assessment, not a calibrated perceptual score.

reported-striped-shirt.verdict: rejected: uploaded pattern and color lost
observations: The actual garment conditioning retains the teal/cream stripes.
The raw model output instead has beige speckled fabric and an invented diagonal neckline. The fidelity guard correctly rejected it; no final image was published.

different-garment.verdict: promising geometry; garment details remain incorrect
observations: Brown color, contrast shoulder/sleeve panels, V neckline and the large 95 graphic transfer recognizably.
Both sleeves and hem are plausible; no large beige-shirt fragments are visible. Face, hands, jeans and background appear preserved.
The sleeve's red maple-leaf print is missing. Small lettering and digit proportions differ; side and underarm boundaries remain rough. Exact garment fidelity is not accepted.

different-person.verdict: rejected: missing sleeves and invented red fabric
observations: Despite the expanded upper-arm mask, the raw and final images remain sleeveless.
The model invents large red fabric regions outside the uploaded shirt's circular print. Skin seams at shoulder and armhole are rough.
The executed mask leaves part of the shoulder cap outside its flat upper boundary. The next rounded-cap revision is a hypothesis to test, not an established quality fix.

shirt-category.verdict: promising prototype candidate with print and edge limitations
observations: The actual person wears a recognizable black graphic T-shirt with round neckline, shoulders, sleeves and a plausible hem.
No large beige-shirt fragments are visible. Face, hands, jeans, shoes and background appear unchanged.
Small print details and text are degraded, with residual underarm/side edge roughness. This does not establish production-quality fitting or arbitrary shirt support.
